biotools.summary: A tool that checks the clinical metadata quality (validity, completeness), the integrity between images and clinical metadata provided as well as their accuracy,  the de-identification protocol applied, and existence of annotation together with the consistency between the images and the annotation files and informs the user on corrective actions prior to data upload.
